name: Muuchstac Mens Ocean Moisturizer & Sunscreen Matte Look Spf 18+ Cream 45ml With Turmeric & Aloe Vera Beads, Non-Sticky & Water Resistant
description:
Product Name: Muuchstac Men’s Ocean Moisturizer & Sunscreen SPF 18+
Volume: 45ml
Scent: Ocean
Skin Type: Suitable for all skin types

Key Features

Natural Ingredients: Enriched with Turmeric (Haldi) and Aloe Vera Beads

Turmeric: Provides antiseptic protection and helps prevent sunburn, dark spots & tanning

Aloe Vera: Moisturizes and soothes the skin

SPF 18+ Formula: Protects skin from harmful UV rays for up to 2 hours in the sun

Non-Sticky & Water Resistant: Quick-absorbing, lightweight, and comfortable for daily use

Paraben-Free: Safe for all skin types
